purpose: Read-only, fail-closed extraction of a proof-gate-compatible, hash-only P1 molecule identity collection from a complete sharded PCQM production-v2 safe-payload release.
required_invariants: The config binds the exact extraction contract, top-level release manifest bytes and SHA-256, production contract, payload-format contract, identity-normalization contract, release ID, and RDKit identity version.
The source release is opened read-only; LMDB is opened with readonly=true, lock=false, create=false and the extractor writes only inside a new output directory.
The full-release manifest, every referenced shard manifest, and every declared shard/global artifact are checked by complete byte count and SHA-256 before use and checked again after use.

The physical release and shard envelopes have closed allowlists. Unknown top-level files, shard files, directories, symlinks, or LMDB files fail closed; LMDB lock.mdb is the only optional non-evidence runtime file.
Shard ranges are contiguous and exactly cover the selected range. Membership, reject-ledger, payload-index, and LMDB key/value streams are checked in lockstep against manifest counts.
Rejected membership rows are verified against their reject-ledger rows and never emitted as molecule identities.

Every admitted LMDB value is independently decoded from the public v2 safe-payload framing. Wire length/SHA-256, array-block SHA-256, canonical header, logical record SHA-256, membership hash, and payload-index hash must all agree.

Every admitted record binds the release, source contract, production contract, identity-normalization contract, adapter harness, member ID, ordinal, storage key, source address, and required RDKit version.

The emitted connectivity identity is record.identity.canonical_connectivity_sha256 and the emitted stereo identity is the equal strict SDF/official identity hash. record.identity.identity_spec_sha256 must equal the frozen identity-normalization contract SHA-256.
LMDB contains exactly the admitted storage keys. Unknown metadata-like or excess keys fail closed; no LMDB metadata key is emitted or silently ignored.
The output contains only member IDs and identity hashes, is strictly UTF-8-key sorted canonical JSONL, and is compatible with the standalone overlap proof gate.
The extractor does not choose a P1/P2 overlap policy, downstream split policy, tokenizer policy, or training-admission decision.
not_an_admission: A passing receipt only establishes a source-bound identity collection for later overlap proof. P1 and P2 training admission remain false.
